newsitem.title: USA: Flextronics to acquire Ericsson units.
newsitem.headline: Flextronics to acquire Ericsson units.

text.p: Flextronics International Ltd said Tuesday it had agreed to purchase production units from Swedish telecommunications giant LM Ericsson.
Ericsson's production plants in Karlskrona, in southern Sweden, manufacture units for business communication systems, as well as components for business cordless and radio access, Flextronics said.
The units have annual turnover of 2.3 million crowns. or $350 million, Flextronics said.
It said it will take over all of the manufacturing activities, including the production plants, and will offer employment to 90 percent of the 1,000 employees there.
Flextronics said it and Ericsson are also in talks for long-term purchasing and collaboration agreements.
